identity.title: NautilusTrader Offline Kernel, ParquetDataCatalog and Deterministic Replay Foundation
identity.objective: Create the repository's first deterministic offline event-replay foundation by adopting NautilusTrader (BinaryOption, InstrumentId/Venue/Price/Quantity, order-book/trade data objects, ParquetDataCatalog, offline BacktestEngine replay) in a new top-level src/research_runtime/nautilus_offline boundary. Verified WP167 pmxt v2 history is deterministically mapped to Nautilus prediction-market instruments and market-data events, registered in a local ParquetDataCatalog, queried, and replayed through the offline engine into a repo-controlled path-independent, mutation-sensitive NautilusReplayReceipt. Adds exactly nautilus_trader==1.231.0 (base install; no Polymarket extra, no Redis, no network). Canonical WP167/PIT truth is read-only and unchanged. Tick-size changes use the finest-tick single-instrument model with a committed regime schedule. No strategy, alpha, fill model, execution edge, paper, live, credentials, WebSocket, Data API, experiment registry, or scheduler.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: Explicit user XL authorization with the frozen decision to create a new top-level src/research_runtime boundary rather than nest under src/data_layer. WP168 is one coherent capability: an offline Nautilus replay kernel (compatibility, instruments, conversion, catalog, replay) plus its focused tests and contract doc. The governance files beyond the capability are mandatory: a new dependency and a new top-level src package trip the architecture-boundary guard, the WP167 exact-pins dependency test, the current-review-target status guards, and the adoption/dependency registry, each preserving every prior WP's exact-scope assertions. Exact governed scope is 35 files, which is the coherent minimum and the schema maximum.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the WP168 branch. The change is additive: one new top-level src/research_runtime/nautilus_offline package with its README, the single dependency nautilus_trader==1.231.0 in pyproject.toml, the CI matrix extension, one contract doc, five focused tests plus one contract-docs test, ten historical governance-guard updates, and status/repo-truth/deferred/security/adoption-registry reconciliation. There is no predecessor mutation, no canonical SQLite/manifest/identity change, no data migration, and no committed generated catalog or dataset.

api_matrix.reason: WP168 changes no existing predecessor public API, so the machine api_matrix (which encodes deltas to a pre-existing public surface) is applicable:false. WP168's public surface is entirely net-new and is frozen instead in docs/wp_specs/WP168/wp_prompt.txt and docs/nautilus_offline_kernel_contract.md, which are the canonical location for net-new API; predecessors and NautilusTrader are imported only through their existing public API.

semantic_fields.reason: The NautilusReplayReceipt and mapping/conversion identity fields are documented in the contract doc and proven by the focused tests and the result-object field-coverage gate; this spec does not re-encode them as governed semantic fields.

identity_derivations.reason: The deterministic instrument identity and replay digest are implemented in code and proven by independent recomputation and mutation-sensitivity tests; this spec does not restate them in the canonical-JSON derivation DSL.

state_transitions.reason: WP168 defines no governed state machine; results are single-shot frozen objects with a closed error vocabulary.

failure_precedence.reason: Fixed schema-1.0.0 failure precedence for the WP-spec guard.

examples.reason: No canonical-JSON identity derivations are declared in this spec, so no worked derivation examples are required.

evidence_plan.reason: Requirement-to-evidence traceability R001-R063 mapping each WP168 requirement to a command and expected result; new-capability pytest nodes live in the frozen exact-scope test modules and the contract-doc test; covers receive-time-primary ordering, canonical serialization and literal identity constants, WP167 external-dataset provenance binding and hash revalidation, the frozen public API/dataclass contract, the pmxt-v2 event-semantic matrix, and two-distinct-surface PR evidence.

the isolated dependency-audit job (python -m pip_audit over the exact installed WP168 closure: nautilus_trader==1.231.0 + WP167 pins) for the exact current head SHA reports conclusion success; this binds the audit to the isolated hosted closure, not a local interpreter
the compatibility result reports NAUTILUS_OFFLINE_RUNTIME_SUPPORTED with empty error codes and execution_authority false; invalid results carry no raw exception or path
required Nautilus offline modules import and the Polymarket extra (py_clob_client_v2) and Redis are not required for the offline path
the BinaryOption InstrumentId is deterministically derived from conditionId + outcome token id on venue POLYMARKET and is path-independent
collateral currency is USDC, asset class ALTERNATIVE, and price/size precision and increments are exact with no float

at the BinaryOptionMarketContext boundary a missing instrument identity and a malformed/noncanonical condition_id fail closed with NAUTILUS_INSTRUMENT_MAPPING_INVALID and no echo; an uppercase (alternate-case) condition_id is rejected because condition_id must already be canonical '0x'+64 lowercase hex (this public context boundary performs no silent normalization; it is distinct from the WP167 source-row market which is case-normalized)
event_type book converts to an OrderBookDeltas snapshot (CLEAR then ADD deltas) preserving levels
event_type price_change converts to an OrderBookDelta UPDATE, or DELETE on zero size
event_type last_trade_price converts to a TradeTick with exact price/size, aggressor side, and trade id
timestamp maps to ts_event and timestamp_received maps to ts_init in nanoseconds
exact Decimal to Nautilus Price/Quantity conversion with no float and no precision loss within FIXED_PRECISION 9

two distinct events with identical ts_init are ordered deterministically by the frozen total key (ts_init, ts_event, event_kind_rank, canonical_row_digest, canonical_row_bytes) with event_kind_rank book=0 < price_change=1 < last_trade_price=2 < tick_size_change=3
unsupported pmxt events and malformed book payloads fail closed with NAUTILUS_EVENT_CONVERSION_INVALID and no echo
a tick_size_change is committed as a repo-controlled tick-size regime transition (finest-tick single-instrument model) and never as a second economic market
the ParquetDataCatalog registers the instrument definition before market data and the catalog path is caller-provided and excluded from logical identity
catalog query reproduces the converted deltas and trades by count and representative price/size/timestamp
catalog write/query failures fail closed with NAUTILUS_CATALOG_WRITE_INVALID or NAUTILUS_CATALOG_QUERY_INVALID and no echo
the bounded offline engine replays one BinaryOption instrument and processes every converted event in the declared deterministic order with no strategy, order, or fill logic
a second replay run produces a byte-identical repo-controlled NautilusReplayReceipt and replay digest
the receipt identity excludes absolute paths, temp dirs, wall-clock, env and CI identifiers, and mutating committed input changes the replay digest
source event counts by type equal converted and replay-processed counts under the declared conversion rules
replay count or digest mismatch fails closed with NAUTILUS_REPLAY_INVALID or NAUTILUS_REPLAY_PARITY_INVALID and no echo
every public NautilusReplayReceipt/result field is enumerated and classified and invalid public results are recursively no-echo scanned

the negative-test matrix maps each applicable category (unsupported python/version/import/instrument/market-id/precision/order/decimal/event/book/catalog/replay-count/replay-digest/no-echo) to a focused test and accounts for all 15 repo negative-test categories; category 14 (case normalization) distinguishes two input domains: an uppercase/alternate-case BinaryOptionMarketContext.condition_id is rejected, while an uppercase/mixed-case WP167 source-row market is accepted and canonicalized to lowercase, and wrong-prefix/wrong-length/non-hex/non-ASCII variants fail closed
exactly the 35 governed WP168 files differ from the frozen base merge-base b79049e (three-dot diff against the exact certified base SHA, not a drifting local main), and nothing else

a scoped import/no-network test proves the nautilus_offline package imports no live data/execution client, no authenticated Polymarket client, no WebSocket/Data API, no credentials, no Redis, no scheduler, and opens no product/runtime network socket (a human git diff is supporting, not the mechanical proof)
no canonical WP167/PIT SQLite, manifest, or identity change; predecessor suites pass

items.expected_result: the PR body is the canonical current-review surface; one REAL optional non-canonical evidence-mirror comment (marked OPTIONAL NON-CANONICAL) exists solely because the current guard CLI still requires a second --final-comment input after WP91; the re-fetched posted PR body and the re-fetched posted optional comment are saved to TWO DISTINCT files (never the same file twice), and the guard run with the resolved 40-char HEAD_SHA (which must appear in the PR body) exits 0; before the independent PASS certificate exists evidence mode is BLOCKED_NOT_READY with the independent certificate as the sole named blocker
the same validated semantic rows presented in different input/file enumeration order produce an identical canonical source ordering (ts_init primary) and an identical replay digest
the same rows after a Parquet physical reorder/rewrite produce an identical canonical ordering and replay digest; source_row_index never derives from physical row position
two byte-identical duplicate source rows are never silently deduplicated and retain multiplicity 2 with deterministic duplicate ordinals 0,1
three byte-identical duplicate source rows retain multiplicity 3 with deterministic duplicate ordinals 0,1,2
duplicate multiplicity 2 versus multiplicity 3 produces a different replay digest (the digest is sensitive to multiplicity)
equal ts_init and equal ts_event with different event types are ordered by the frozen event_kind_rank book<price_change<last_trade_price<tick_size_change
equal ts_init and ts_event and the same event kind but different semantic row content are ordered deterministically by canonical_row_digest then canonical_row_bytes

raw source/query/Parquet physical row index is never part of the logical replay identity; the replay digest is insensitive to arbitrary physical ordering but sensitive to semantic content and multiplicity
every validated historical price is an exact integer multiple of the selected finest price increment; conversion fails closed with NAUTILUS_EVENT_CONVERSION_INVALID otherwise

when venue ts_event order disagrees with receive ts_init order, the canonical ordering and engine dispatch follow ts_init (point-in-time knowability); the implementation test also proves the engine (add_data sort=True, or sort=False if required on 1.231.0) preserves the canonical equal-ts_init tie order

the contract-doc test asserts every public function signature (evaluate_offline_runtime, build_binary_option, convert_pmxt_v2_events, build_catalog, query_catalog, run_offline_replay) and every public dataclass field/type exactly, and that the contract contains no ellipsis or may-be-refined language

convert_pmxt_v2_events fails closed NAUTILUS_EVENT_CONVERSION_INVALID when descriptor.provider_id/dataset_name/dataset_version/source_class do not equal PMXT_V2_PROVIDER_ID/PMXT_V2_DATASET_NAME/PMXT_V2_DATASET_VERSION/PMXT_V2_SOURCE_CLASS
an extra source file, a missing descriptor object, or a duplicate object_name each fail closed; a strict 1:1 bijection by identical object_name and partition_identity is required
a local file whose content no longer matches the matched ExternalSourceObject.source_sha256 (revalidated via revalidate_pmxt_v2_source_hash) fails closed with no raw path/exception echo
presenting the same source files/rows in a different physical enumeration order yields identical canonical ordering and an identical replay_digest
PmxtV2SourceFile.path is input-only: no absolute/relative source path or temp/catalog_dir appears in any ConvertedEventStream/NautilusReplayReceipt identity field or public output

NautilusReplayReceipt.source_external_dataset_id equals ExternalDatasetDescriptor.external_dataset_id and source_dataset_kind == WP167_EXTERNAL_DATASET_DESCRIPTOR; mutating external_dataset_id or a source hash changes or invalidates the replay identity

owned fields per event_type (book: bids/asks; price_change: price/size/side/best_bid/best_ask; last_trade_price: price/size/side/fee_rate_bps/transaction_hash; tick_size_change: old_tick_size/new_tick_size) are required non-null, unowned event-specific fields must be null, and side is within BUY/SELL; violations fail closed

book bids/asks parse as strict JSON arrays of 2-string pairs; bids canonicalize to strictly descending price and asks to strictly ascending price; malformed JSON, a non-2-item pair, a non-exact decimal, or a duplicate price level on one side each fail closed

the literal constants CONVERSION_POLICY_VERSION=wp168-nautilus-pmxt-v2-conversion/1.0.0, REPLAY_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_ID/VERSION, and REPLAY_IDENTITY_PREFIX=nautilusreplay:sha256: are present; an independent recomputation of the SHA-256 canonical-JSON preimage reproduces replay_digest; mutating an included preimage field changes it while changing an excluded path/temp value does not
